def solution():
    # Define variables
    unlevered_firm_value = 800_000
    debt = 300_000
    interest_rate = 0.05
    tax_rate = 0.28
    periods = 5

    # Calculate the present value of the interest tax shield
    annual_tax_shield = debt * interest_rate * tax_rate
    pv_tax_shield = annual_tax_shield * (
        1 - (1 / (1 + interest_rate) ** periods)
    ) / interest_rate

    # Calculate APV
    apv = unlevered_firm_value + pv_tax_shield

    # Return APV rounded to the nearest integer
    return round(apv)
